(Currently amended) Claim 1: A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is defined as having a degree of flexibility sufficient to maintain a seal under varying pressure conditions.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, and wherein the tapered portion has an included angle of less than 40 degrees.

(Currently amended) Claim 7: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is defined by an included angle of less than 40 degrees.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, and wherein the compliant seal is characterized by a degree of flexibility that allows for effective sealing under high pressure conditions.

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, wherein the seal retainer is configured to maintain the compliant seal in a position that ensures effective sealing against the tapered fluid conduit.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, and wherein the compliant seal is defined by a material that exhibits a degree of flexibility suitable for high-pressure applications.
